get.summary: Get destination suggestions for tour discovery (User Story 4)
get.description: Public endpoint for registered and non-registered customers. Returns unique destination suggestions from currently available tours by case-insensitive partial matching.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: The destination query string to search for. Minimum 3 characters.

200.description: A list of destinations matching the query

400.description: Bad Request - destination query is missing or shorter than 3 characters

errors.destination: destination must be at least 3 characters long

500.description: Internal server error while reading tour data

get.summary: Get a paginated list of available tours (User Story 4)
get.description: Public endpoint for registered and non-registered customers. Only tours marked available and meeting all provided filter conditions are returned.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve. Must be an integer >= 1. Default is 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of items per page. Must be an integer between 1 and 50. Default is 6.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial destination filter.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter lower bound date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter upper bound date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration filter; supports exact values (e.g. '7 days'), numeric ranges (e.g. '8-12 days'), and open-ended values (e.g. '12+ days').

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Requested adult guest count. Must be an integer >= 0.

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Requested children guest count. Must be an integer >= 0. At least one total guest is required.

parameters.name: mealPlan
parameters.description: Meal plan filter. Comma-separated values are supported. Allowed values: BB, HB, FB, AI.

parameters.name: tourType
parameters.description: Tour type filter. Comma-separated values are supported. Allowed values: RESORT, CRUISE, HIKE.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort by RATING_DESC (Top rated first), RATING_ASC (Low rated first), PRICE_DESC (Highest price first), or PRICE_ASC (Lowest price first). Default is RATING_DESC.

200.description: A paginated list of available tours. Can be an empty result set when filters match no tours.

400.description: Bad Request - one or more query parameters are invalid

errors.startDate: startDate must be in YYYY-MM-DD format
errors.sortBy: sortBy must be one of RATING_DESC, RATING_ASC, PRICE_DESC, PRICE_ASC

500.description: Internal server error while reading tour data
